description:
Ahn Cha-Woo is the ultimate magnet for terrible boyfriends. Every relationship ends the same way, and the latest one does not even last six months before ending in betrayal. Why is love never on his side? Is it really too much to hope for a boyfriend who is polite, handsome, fit, and, well, generously endowed? Cha-Woo cannot help feeling the universe is being unfair. 

 *“Forget it. I am done with dating.”*

But just as he swears off romance, someone catches his eye, Nam Do-Ha, who happens to be polite, handsome, fit, and…everything else on his list. Of course, Do-Ha looks like the definition of a straight campus golden boy, so Cha-Woo quickly crushes his own interest. Until Doha suddenly lights up and says, “Wow, really? Then could you buy me lunch tomorrow?” A throwaway comment, taken seriously. Maybe, just maybe, this time will be different.

(Source: Lezhin US)
